label: 立春
title: 春天从一枚新芽开始
title_en: Spring begins with a single bud
description: 把好奇种下，让新的故事慢慢生长。
description_en: Plant a little curiosity and give new stories room to grow.

label: 雨水
title: 听雨落下，等万物醒来
title_en: Listen to the rain, wait for the world to wake
description: 雨丝轻叩窗沿，思绪也有了清新的回声。
description_en: Rain taps the window and gives each thought a fresh echo.

label: 惊蛰
title: 春雷之后，灵感苏醒
title_en: After spring thunder, ideas awaken
description: 藏了一冬的念头，开始闪烁自己的微光。
description_en: Ideas tucked away all winter begin to glow.

label: 春分
title: 把日光与心事平分
title_en: Share the day between light and thought
description: 燕子掠过晴空，忙碌和留白恰好平衡。
description_en: Swallows cross a bright sky; work and quiet find their balance.

label: 清明
title: 风清景明，且行且记
title_en: Clear skies, small walks, lasting notes
description: 柳枝轻摆，把沿途值得记住的事写下来。
description_en: Willow branches sway; write down the things worth keeping.

label: 谷雨
title: 一场雨，养出新的答案
title_en: A little rain brings new answers
description: 茶芽与细雨相逢，让想法慢慢舒展。
description_en: Tea shoots meet fine rain and thoughts slowly unfurl.

label: 立夏
title: 夏天来信，绿意正浓
title_en: Summer arrives in a letter of green
description: 荷叶接住微风，日常开始有了明亮的节奏。
description_en: Lotus leaves catch the breeze as everyday life finds a brighter rhythm.

label: 小满
title: 小得盈满，刚刚好
title_en: Just enough is a lovely kind of plenty
description: 麦穗渐满，给正在成长的事多一点耐心。
description_en: Grain fills the ears; give growing things a little more time.

label: 芒种
title: 种下热爱，收获日常
title_en: Sow what you love, gather everyday moments
description: 金色麦浪之间，把认真留给眼前的小事。
description_en: Between golden waves of wheat, give small things your full attention.

label: 夏至
title: 把最长的日光留给热爱
title_en: Give the longest daylight to what you love
description: 太阳沿着长长的弧线，照亮尚未写完的故事。
description_en: The sun takes a long arc across stories still being written.

label: 小暑
title: 荷风送来一段清凉
title_en: A lotus breeze brings a cooler moment
description: 听水面轻响，让思绪在盛夏也保持轻盈。
description_en: Listen to the water and keep your thoughts light through summer.

label: 大暑
title: 盛夏深处，慢一点也好
title_en: At the height of summer, take your time
description: 热浪轻晃，云影缓行，给日常留一口清风。
description_en: Heat shimmers and clouds drift; leave a little room for a breeze.

label: 立秋
title: 一片叶子，先替秋天落笔
title_en: A single leaf starts autumn's story
description: 暑意未尽，风里已经藏着新的篇章。
description_en: Summer lingers, but the wind already carries a new chapter.

label: 处暑
title: 暑气渐退，心绪舒展
title_en: As the heat fades, let your thoughts open
description: 流云慢慢散开，把清爽留给下一段旅程。
description_en: Clouds slowly part and leave a clearer path for what comes next.

label: 白露
title: 清晨的露，照见小小世界
title_en: Morning dew holds a tiny world
description: 在草叶上的一滴光里，发现日常的细节。
description_en: Find the details of everyday life in a drop of light on a blade of grass.

label: 秋分
title: 一半丰盈，一半留白
title_en: Half a season of plenty, half a page of quiet
description: 把收获收好，也把安静的时间留给自己。
description_en: Keep what the season has given and save a little quiet for yourself.

label: 寒露
title: 露凉风轻，适合静读
title_en: Cool dew and a light breeze, a day for reading
description: 薄雾穿过山谷，文字在清凉里慢慢沉淀。
description_en: Mist crosses the valley while words settle into the cool air.

label: 霜降
title: 霜落枝头，故事有了轮廓
title_en: Frost touches the branches and stories take shape
description: 银白描过叶缘，让纷杂的想法变得清晰。
description_en: Silver traces the leaves and brings scattered thoughts into focus.

label: 立冬
title: 冬日有光，故事在屋里继续
title_en: Winter light, and stories inside
description: 窗内灯火渐暖，为安静的时光添一点温度。
description_en: A warm window adds a little comfort to the quieter hours.

label: 小雪
title: 第一场雪，轻轻落在日常里
title_en: The first snow falls softly into everyday life
description: 细雪缓缓飘落，把世界的声音调低一点。
description_en: Small snowflakes fall and turn the world's volume down.

label: 大雪
title: 雪落成诗，慢读一整个冬天
title_en: Snow turns to verse; read slowly through winter
description: 远山渐白，故事在一层层雪色里安静展开。
description_en: Distant hills turn white as stories unfold through layers of snow.

label: 冬至
title: 长夜尽头，总有一盏暖灯
title_en: A warm light waits at the end of the longest night
description: 白昼虽短，团聚与希望可以很长。
description_en: The day may be short; togetherness and hope need not be.

label: 小寒
title: 岁寒天清，把热爱慢慢写
title_en: Clear cold days, and time to write what you love
description: 冰枝映着微光，心里的温度不必随风降低。
description_en: Ice catches a little light; keep the things you love warm.

label: 大寒
title: 寒意深处，等一枝梅开
title_en: Deep in the cold, wait for a plum blossom
description: 最冷的时节里，新的春天已经悄悄准备。
description_en: In the coldest days, a new spring is already taking shape.

label: 春节
title: 灯火团圆，新岁启程
title_en: Lanterns, reunions, and a new year begins
description: 红灯映雪，烟花照亮归家的路，把新岁的祝愿写进第一页。
description_en: Red lanterns glow through the snow as fireworks light the road home.

label: 元宵节
title: 花灯映月，人间团圆
title_en: Lanterns and moonlight gather people together
description: 一盏盏花灯升起，谜语、笑声与月色一起落入夜色。
description_en: Lanterns rise into the night, carrying riddles, laughter, and moonlight.

label: 端午节
title: 鼓声逐浪，粽叶飘香
title_en: Drums across the water and the fragrance of zongzi
description: 龙舟划开碧水，艾草与粽香把仲夏的祝福送到岸边。
description_en: Dragon boats cross green water as mugwort and zongzi carry summer blessings.

label: 七夕
title: 星河为桥，心意相逢
title_en: A bridge of stars brings hearts together
description: 银河横过夜空，让相隔的星光在这一晚温柔相会。
description_en: Across the Milky Way, distant lights meet in a gentle reunion.

label: 中秋节
title: 月满人间，桂香入梦
title_en: A full moon, autumn fragrance, and dreams of home
description: 一轮圆月升起，桂花香里装着团聚、思念与远方。
description_en: Under a full moon, osmanthus carries reunion, longing, and distance.

label: 重阳节
title: 登高望远，菊香满径
title_en: Climb high, look far, and follow the chrysanthemums
description: 秋山染金，菊花沿路盛开，把问候送给牵挂的人。
description_en: Golden autumn hills and chrysanthemums carry greetings to those we miss.

label: 元旦
title: 新年的第一束光
title_en: The first light of a new year
description: 烟火越过午夜，新的日历从此刻翻开，愿每段旅程都有光。
description_en: Fireworks cross midnight as a new calendar opens with light for every journey.

label: 情人节
title: 把喜欢写成一场花开
title_en: Let affection bloom into flowers
description: 玫瑰色的风经过这里，每一颗心意都有温柔的回声。
description_en: A rose-colored breeze passes by, giving every feeling a gentle echo.

label: 劳动节
title: 认真生活，也认真休息
title_en: Work with care, and rest with care
description: 每一份踏实的努力都值得被看见，也别忘了留时间照顾自己。
description_en: Every honest effort deserves recognition; remember to make time for rest.

label: 世界地球日
title: 让每一次呼吸更清澈
title_en: Breathe clearer with every choice
description: 山川与海洋共享同一颗蓝色星球，让绿色的选择从今天开始。
description_en: Mountains and oceans share one blue planet; let greener choices begin today.

label: 万圣节
title: 月光之下，奇想出没
title_en: When moonlight lets imagination roam
description: 南瓜灯亮起，蝙蝠掠过月亮，今夜的故事带一点神秘。
description_en: Jack-o'-lanterns glow and bats cross the moon; tonight's stories carry a little mystery.

label: 圣诞节
title: 星光落在温柔的冬夜
title_en: Starlight settles over a gentle winter night
description: 树梢点亮彩灯，雪花落向窗前，把祝福装进小小的礼物盒。
description_en: Lights glow on the tree as snow settles by the window and blessings fill small gifts.
